revision_summary: Two minor quote-formatting issues: the '100,000. Okay. Pretty expensive.' quote in cherry_pick_moments[1] and coaching_focus[1] merges two separate timestamped lines ([00:40] '100,000.' and [00:41] 'Okay. Pretty expensive.') into one quote attributed only to 00:40 — split or re-timestamp to '00:40-00:41' for accuracy. On revision: (1) resolve the classification confusion around the bill-capture-without-flip event — currently split into an 'enthusiasm_signal' entry (00:36) and an 'objection_inversion_miss' entry (00:40) describing the same underlying moment; consolidate into one bill_anchoring cherry-pick with a schema-appropriate classification label. (2) Fix the classification label on the 03:22 entry — 'curiosity_creation_failure' does not match the cited schema section (bill_collection alternative paths); rename to something like 'tech_friction_handling' or 'bill_collection_pivot_miss'. (3) Add the missed moment at 01:08 where the customer gives an ambiguous/non-answer on credit score ('I have a bigger credit score... it fluctuates') and the rep simply says 'we can check it out' without qualifying — this is a direct live instance of the schema's flagged credit-qualifier policy ambiguity and is more coachable than the 650-vs-670 drift note alone. (4) Consider flagging the observed_outcome as conditional/fragile in the structured outcome block (not just in trajectory_verdict prose), given skipped button-up, uncaptured bill, and unresolved credit status — consistent with schema's treatment of fragile bookings under the setter compensation model. (5) Soften two superlative claims ('single most consequential relational moment,' 'single best flip opportunity') to call-local framing rather than corpus-wide ranking language.
